cases.method: Synthetic isolated ten-monster population on actual terrain. One initial knight level2 / starter+3 fixture and population filter; unchanged full target HP/UID/levels. Then ordinary movement, ten sequential battles, return/sale/buy/use/restock through live commands. No between-fight resource/HP/position reset; no free HP regeneration. This is not a full-1151-population validation.
